Definition: {properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)}
BiblicalUsage: A cubit, the forearm, the measure of the builders, and the Bible measures its great things in it. Nebuchadnezzar's image is threescore cubits high and six cubits broad, set up in the plain of Dura. And Cyrus decrees the house of God at Jerusalem shall be threescore cubits high and threescore cubits broad, the foundations strongly laid; the word is the elbow to the fingertip, and empires and temples are both built by it.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for a cubit carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the two buildings, that the king's image and God's house are both threescore cubits high, and only one of them stands.
